items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: And of course you have Basie and Ellington, but they were always—

ctx.x: Who were the really hot bands at that time? © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
Well that’s when Miller actually came to the top. Shaw was still a hot band. Benny I guess had dropped some. I mean the swing bands. And of course you have Basie and Ellington, but they were always—
Always there. So when you got hired on to Glenn Miller, what kind of salary did he offer you?
